heading.title: Market Expectations for Future Central Bank Rates

figures.source_line: Source: Bloomberg, Factset as of 5/31/25. Data provided is for informational use only. See end of report for important additional information. Forecasts/estimates are based on current market conditions, subject to change, and may not necessarily come to pass.

components.evidence: Two titled charts side by side: "Central Bank Policy Rates" and "Market Expectations for Future Central Bank Rates"
"Source: Bloomberg, Factset as of 5/31/25. Data provided is for informational use only..." under both plots
"BOE", "U.S. Federal Reserve", "ECB", "BOJ" written in colour next to the lines, no legend
"U.S. Federal Reserve", "BOE", "ECB", "BOJ" printed beside each line's left endpoint
Series names drawn over the plot area, e.g. "BOE" above the grey line near '06
All four policy-rate lines move in horizontal treads and vertical risers
BOJ drawn as a blue dashed line while BOE, Fed and ECB are solid
BOJ series drawn dashed blue; other three series solid
Lowest tick reads "(1%)" and ECB/BOJ lines sit at or just below 0%
Monthly step data but ticks only every two years: '98, '00, '02 ... '24
Ticks written as bare two-digit years with apostrophe: "'98", "'00", "'24"
Each point labelled beside the marker, e.g. "4.27%" above, "3.54%" below the line
Table with headers "Current, 1-Mo. Ago, 12-Mo. Ago" and rows "U.S. Federal Reserve, BOE, BOJ, ECB"
The rates table is drawn over the top-right of the plot area, covering the 8-10% region
Four monthly step series spanning '98 to '24, several hundred plotted points

new_components.name: table_overlaid_on_plot
new_components.evidence: Current/1-Mo. Ago/12-Mo. Ago table with banded rows sits inside the chart's upper-right plot area
new_components.why_it_matters: 表格与折线共享同一图形区，解析时同一图既产生表格行（4行×3列），又产生需从像素读取的折线值，取值必须先判定数字来自表格还是曲线。

new_components.name: percent_ticks_on_all_labels
new_components.evidence: Every value tick and label already carries "%": "10%", "0.0%", "4.27%"
new_components.why_it_matters: 单位直接写在刻度和数值标签里，没有独立单位行，检索时数值字符串必须带百分号才能匹配。

new_components.name: zebra_striped_table_rows
new_components.evidence: Alternating shaded rows: "U.S. Federal Reserve" and "BOJ" rows tinted grey, BOE/ECB white
new_components.why_it_matters: 行底色仅作阅读辅助，不编码数值，避免把底色误读为附加变量。

difficulty_notes: 被评分的10个值全部印在f2上，读数不是障碍（每点都有两位小数标签）；难点在寻址：f2无图例，四个系列名（U.S. Federal Reserve、BOE、ECB、BOJ）只以彩色文字贴在各线左端，解析器若不把颜色/位置还原成系列名，20个点就只剩"3M…3Y"五个列名，4.27%与4.11%都落在3M列而无法区分。另外同名标签（U.S. Federal Reserve、BOE、ECB、BOJ）也出现在f1叠加表格的行名里，且f1表格里有4.50%、4.25%这类同量级数值，一行若缺少图标题"Market Expectations for Future Central Bank Rates"就会与"Central Bank Policy Rates"的表格混淆，因此一个值需要图标题+系列名+期限三重键。

suggestions.what_to_add: inline_series_labels（端点内联系列名，无图例）
suggestions.where_to_change: 样式条件行：legend_mode 增加 "inline_endpoint" 取值，渲染时把系列名以系列色写在首点或末点旁
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 图例位置消融：legend_below / legend_inside / inline_endpoint 三档下，系列名能否进入表格行头的成功率

suggestions.what_to_add: 新组件 table_overlaid_on_plot（数据表压在折线图形区内）
suggestions.where_to_change: 图形记录字段：新增 overlay_table 块（表头、行名、单元格），与折线 series 共存于同一 figure
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 同一图内"表格值 vs 曲线值"来源歧义行：有/无叠加表时数值归属判定错误率

suggestions.where_to_change: 折线族样式字段 line_interpolation 增加 "step" 档，并在时间轴上启用月度密点
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 插值方式消融：linear vs step 时，稀疏刻度（每两年一格）下取点年份定位误差

suggestions.what_to_add: unit_in_axis_or_title 的替代形态：刻度与数值标签自带 %（percent_ticks_on_all_labels）
suggestions.where_to_change: 刻度格式字段 tick_format：区分 "bare number + unit line" 与 "每个标签带 % 后缀"
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位位置消融：单位在轴标题 / 单位随每个刻度与数值标签时，检索字符串带不带 % 的命中率

suggestions.what_to_add: negative_values 与 (1%) 括号负值刻度
suggestions.where_to_change: 数值轴条件行：负号呈现方式增加 "parenthesis" 取值，最低刻度可低于 0
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 负值书写消融：-1% 与 (1%) 两种写法下零线以下值的解析正确率
